title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We are excited to announce that Spyglass is now officially launched, bringing enhanced capabilities to your workflow.

title: Advanced File Control in Your Editor
summary: Take charge of your content with new editor tools that allow you to seamlessly upload, manage, and customize the visual presentation of all your embedded files.

title: Introducing Our Public Roadmap
summary: Explore our new public roadmap to effortlessly track our latest shipped features, see what's coming next, and discover exciting plans for the future of our product.

title: Revamped Checkboxes: Easier, Smoother, More Stylish
summary: Experience a seamless task management workflow with our enhanced checkboxes, now featuring bigger, more modern designs that are both effortlessly clickable and fully draggable.

title: Seamless Real-time Collaboration
summary: Our upgraded editor now makes working together effortless, providing crystal-clear insights into your team's real-time contributions.

title: Enhanced Sharing & Collaboration
summary: We've made it easier than ever to share and collaborate on your ideas and quests, significantly enhancing the visibility and utility of shared items.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out robust support for international languages across our platform.

title: Open Source Noeko
summary: We're thrilled to announce Noeko is going open source, empowering our community with unprecedented control, direct involvement, and complete transparency in its future development.

title: Unlocking Your Knowledge Connections
summary: Dive deeper into your insights with enhanced visualization tools, allowing you to filter, organize, and share your network of ideas more effectively.

title: Precision Search & Dynamic Collections
summary: Effortlessly pinpoint and organize your insights with a comprehensive new search experience that includes powerful filtering by tags and dates, plus the ability to save your refined searches as custom Compendiums.

title: Dynamic Content Previews
summary: This feature introduces versatile new ways to display linked content, from simple references to rich previews, empowering you to structure your notes more intuitively.

title: Introducing Noeko Self-Hosting and Premium Plans
summary: Soon, you'll be able to host Noeko on your own servers and access new premium features tailored to your needs, giving you ultimate control and flexibility.

title: Personalize Your Experience with Expanded Theme Options
summary: Discover a more personalized and visually appealing Noeko as we refine current themes and introduce a diverse array of fresh new looks.

title: Smarter Greetings for Every Moment
summary: Enjoy perfectly timed greetings that genuinely reflect the current moment, making your experience more welcoming and precise.

title: Enhanced Tag List Management
summary: Effortlessly organize your content by quickly removing tags and taking actions on multiple items directly within your tag lists, saving you valuable time.

title: Connect All Your Content
summary: We're dramatically expanding the types of content you can bring into the platform, including YouTube videos, websites, and text documents, to give you a unified and powerful way to manage all your information.
